# Contribution

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Contribution`](gmeow-Contribution.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Contribution>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

A reified relator binding a contributor ([`Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)), a contribution target (a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md), [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md), [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md), or [`Item`](gmeow-Item.md)), a contribution role, and an optional degree, carrying provenance, period, and confidence. THE universal credit construct; creative authorship, CRediT research roles, and mapping/software authorship are all Contributions. Flat shortcuts ([`gmeow:hasAuthor`](../properties/gmeow-hasAuthor.md), [`gmeow:hasTranslator`](../properties/gmeow-hasTranslator.md), …) cover the 80% query case.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Contribution`](gmeow-Contribution.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
